# mapbox static

Static API

Static map images and raster tiles rendered from a Mapbox style.

2 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox static get-image

Retrieve a static map image

Render a static map image from a Mapbox style at a specified center
point, zoom level, bearing, and pitch, with one or more overlays such
as markers, encoded polyline paths, or GeoJSON features.

The `bearing` and `pitch` path segments are optional and default to `0`,
so `{lon},{lat},{zoom}`, `{lon},{lat},{zoom},{bearing}` and
`{lon},{lat},{zoom},{bearing},{pitch}` are all valid.

The response image format depends on the style: vector-only styles
return PNG, raster-only styles return JPEG. You can override this by
appending a format extension to the URL (e.g., `.png`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`).

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/static/{overlay}/{lon},{lat},{zoom},{bearing},{pitch}/{width}x{height}{highRes}{format}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | The ID of the map style to render. Sent in the request path. |
| `overlay` | `OVERLAY` | yes | string |  | One or more overlay features to render on the map, separated by commas. Sent in the request path. Pass an empty string to leave it out of the URL. |
| `lon` | `LON` | yes | number |  | Longitude of the map center. Sent in the request path. |
| `lat` | `LAT` | yes | number |  | Latitude of the map center. Sent in the request path. |
| `zoom` | `ZOOM` | yes | number |  | Zoom level. Fractional values are rounded to two decimal places. Sent in the request path. |
| `bearing` | `BEARING` | yes | number |  | Bearing (rotation) of the map in degrees clockwise from north. Defaults to `0`. Sent in the request path. |
| `pitch` | `PITCH` | yes | number |  | Pitch (tilt) of the map in degrees. `0` is looking straight down; `60` is the maximum. Sent in the request path. |
| `width` | `WIDTH` | yes | integer |  | Width of the output image in pixels. Sent in the request path. |
| `height` | `HEIGHT` | yes | integer |  | Height of the output image in pixels. Sent in the request path. |
| `highRes` | `HIGH_RES` | yes | string | `@2x`, `""` | Render the image at 2x scale (Retina/HiDPI). Use `@2x` to double the pixel density of the output image while keeping the same logical dimensions, or pass an empty string for standard resolution. Sent in the request path. Pass an empty string to leave it out of the URL. |
| `format` | `FORMAT` | yes | string | `.png`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`, `""` | File extension that sets the output image format, appended directly after the dimensions and optional `@2x` (for example `600x400@2x. Sent in the request path. Pass an empty string to leave it out of the URL. |
| `addlayer` | `--addlayer ADDLAYER` | no | string |  | A JSON object representing a Mapbox style layer to add to the map before rendering. Maximum one per request. Cannot be combined with `setfilter`. Sent in the request query. |
| `attribution` | `--attribution` | no | boolean |  | Whether to include map attribution on the image. Sent in the request query. |
| `before-layer` | `--before-layer BEFORE_LAYER` | no | string |  | ID of a style layer. When provided, overlays are inserted into the style directly below this layer. Useful for placing overlays beneath labels. Sent in the request query. |
| `layer-id` | `--layer-id LAYER_ID` | no | string |  | The ID of the style layer to which `setfilter` is applied. Sent in the request query. |
| `logo` | `--logo` | no | boolean |  | Whether to include the Mapbox logo on the image. Sent in the request query. |
| `setfilter` | `--setfilter SETFILTER` | no | string |  | A JSON array representing a Mapbox GL filter expression to apply to an existing layer. Maximum one per request. Requires `layer_id`. Cannot be combined with `addlayer`. Sent in the request query. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox static get-image --username USERNAME STYLE_ID OVERLAY 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 @2x .png
```

### mapbox static get-tile

Retrieve a static raster tile

Render a single raster tile from a Mapbox style at the specified zoom
level and tile coordinates.

The default tile size is 512 x 512 pixels. Use `256` for the
`tilesize` parameter to request 256 x 256 tiles. Note that 512 px
tiles at zoom `z` show the same geographic area as 256 px tiles at
zoom `z+1`, so 256 px tiles require 4x as many requests for the same
coverage.

Append `@2x` for Retina/HiDPI rendering, which doubles pixel density
(e.g., a 512 px tile becomes 1024 x 1024 pixels).

The response image format depends on the style: vector-only styles
return PNG, raster-only styles return JPEG. You can override this by
appending a format extension to the URL (e.g., `.png`, `.jpeg`,
`.webp`).

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/tiles/{tilesize}/{z}/{x}/{y}{highRes}{format}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | The ID of the map style to render. Sent in the request path. |
| `tilesize` | `TILESIZE` | yes | integer | `256`, `512` | Tile dimensions in pixels. `512` (default) produces 512 x 512 tiles; `256` produces 256 x 256 tiles. 512 px tiles at zoom `z` cover the same area as 256 px tiles at zoom `z+1`. Sent in the request path. |
| `z` | `Z` | yes | integer |  | Zoom level (0-22). Sent in the request path. |
| `x` | `X` | yes | integer |  | Tile column (x coordinate) per the slippy-map tile scheme. Sent in the request path. |
| `y` | `Y` | yes | integer |  | Tile row (y coordinate) per the slippy-map tile scheme. Sent in the request path. |
| `highRes` | `HIGH_RES` | yes | string | `@2x`, `""` | Render the tile at 2x scale (Retina/HiDPI). Use `@2x` to double the pixel density of the output tile while keeping the same logical dimensions, or pass an empty string for standard resolution. Sent in the request path. Pass an empty string to leave it out of the URL. |
| `format` | `FORMAT` | yes | string | `.png`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`, `""` | File extension that sets the output image format, appended directly after the tile coordinates and optional `@2x` (for example `6160@2x. Sent in the request path. Pass an empty string to leave it out of the URL. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox static get-tile --username USERNAME STYLE_ID 256 0 0 0 @2x .png
```
